Acinetobacter baumannii strain ABMTRAAP01M environmental isolate from cattle manure, Mymensingh, Bangladesh

Comment.Paragraph: This sample represents an environmental isolate of Acinetobacter baumannii obtained from cattle manure collected in Mymensingh, Bangladesh. The isolate was recovered during a study investigating the occurrence, genomic characteristics, and antimicrobial resistance potential of environmental Acinetobacter baumannii. Genomic analysis was performed to explore virulence factors and resistance genes associated with this organism.
